verses.text: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
lines: God, you have rejected us.
You have broken us down.
You have been angry.
Restore us, again.

verses.text: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
lines: You have made the land tremble.
You have torn it.
Mend its fractures,
for it quakes.

verses.text: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
lines: You have shown your people hard things.
You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

verses.text: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth.
lines: You have given a banner to those who fear you,
that it may be displayed because of the truth.

verses.text: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
lines: So that your beloved may be delivered,
save with your right hand, and answer us.

verses.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
lines: God has spoken from his sanctuary:
“I will triumph.
I will divide Shechem,
and measure out the valley of Succoth.

verses.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
lines: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine.
Ephraim also is the defense of my head.
Judah is my scepter.

verses.text: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
lines: Moab is my wash basin.
I will throw my sandal on Edom.
I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
lines: Who will bring me into the strong city?
Who has led me to Edom?

verses.text: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
lines: Haven’t you, God, rejected us?
You don’t go out with our armies, God.

verses.text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
lines: Give us help against the adversary,
for the help of man is vain.

verses.text: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
lines: Through God we will do valiantly,
for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
